title: Purana sona bechne par poora paisa kyun nahi milta?
hooks: Raghav ne 22K ki chain bechi, par cash kam mila. Kyun?
Purana sona bech rahe ho? Ye 3 wajah se paisa kat-ta hai.
Gold bechne gaye aur rate kam mila? Ye galti mat karna.
hook_why: It starts with a relatable problem (getting less money) which directly addresses the viewer's curiosity about the topic.
metaphor: Gold valuation as a balance: Gross weight vs Net gold weight after removing impurities.
mechanism: Suno... jeweller pehle XRF machine se sona check karta hai.
Us machine ki ray batati hai sona kitna khara hai.
Phir woh patthar aur solder ka wazan kaat deta hai.
Yeh 1 se 3 percent tak ho sakta hai.
Making charges? Woh toh wapas milte hi nahi.
Kyunki woh banwane ki mehnat thi, sona nahi.
Ab bachta hai shuddh sona ka wazan.
Uske hisaab se aaj ka bhav lagta hai.
Agar GST banta hai, toh woh bhi kaat lete hain.
Aakhir mein... likhit receipt zaroor maango.
caption:
Purana sona bechne par poora paisa kyun nahi milta? 🧐

Making charges aur solder ki wajah se resale value kam ho jaati hai. Hamesha purity test karwayein aur rates compare karein.

Save karo, kaam aayega 📌

Kya aapne kabhi sona becha hai? Comments mein batao.

Education only, not financial advice.
